comment: Independent wizard-mode punishment setup for display.c feel_location. Leading space dismisses startup More; !tips avoids the optional farlook tutorial; Ctrl-W wishes for a scroll of punishment, r/o reads it, the following space dismisses the reading message, Ctrl-T opens the teleport location prompt, and the final space selects the current square. This reaches the punished ball/chain memory branch through the live getpos caller.
